description: HELD VOCABULARY extending procedural_grammar for the CLASSIFY-BY-CODEBOOK-JOIN rule shape (the recurring media_analysis/actor_goals slice: match a FACT collection to a CODEBOOK collection on a shared field, then mint a classification node). Two new grammatical classes, each a Concept carrying a proc_role: a `join_verb` (matches/match) marks the shared-field JOIN clause ('a signal's kind MATCHES a tag's kind'), and a `classify` effect_verb (classify/categorise/label) marks the MINT of the classification node ('classify a hit'). The procedural reader (domains/procedural_reader.py) recognises these off this held table exactly as it does the base grammar; drop a Concept to teach a synonym, no code change. Loaded on-demand by ensure_proc_grammar (guarded by a join_verb sentinel) so a normal agent boot does not carry it - the same on-demand discipline procedural_grammar.json itself uses.
